name: manuscript
description: The single evaluation selection used for every manuscript test-performance table, interval and figure. Training and validation memberships are not affected.

weighting.pixel: each glacier has unit weight, split equally across its realizations and then across target pixels in each realization
weighting.glacier_wide: errors averaged over realizations within a glacier, then equally over glaciers
weighting.specific_error_support: full valid reference support of the glacier (n_valid_glacier_pixels), not the void area
weighting.integrated_error: per-glacier volume-rate error = specific error x valid reference area; no regional totals and no density conversion

main.scheme: np.random.SeedSequence([seed, block_size, family, region_code]) as in 05_spatial_block_bootstrap.py

coordinates.scheme: one RNG used sequentially for Western then Eastern draws; combined interval is region-stratified

display.contrasts: comparison minus baseline; coordinates off minus on; bias contrasts subtract magnitudes of means
